## Kota Mandiri Suvarna Sutera

Suvarna Sutera adalah kota mandiri kedua Perseroan yang terletak di kawasan Pasar Kemis, Tangerang yang mempunyai izin pengembangan seluas 2.600 hektar dan berjarak sekitar 15 km dari Kota Mandiri Alam Sutera. Kota mandiri ini didesain oleh Sasaki, Walker \& Associates (SWA Group), perancang tata kota kelas dunia dari Amerika Serikat, yang mengintegrasikan kawasan hunian, komersial, retail, dan perkantoran untuk memberikan kenyamanan bagi warganya.

Pengembangan Suvarna Sutera terbagi dalam beberapa fase, di mana fase pertama pembangunan adalah seluas 900 hektar. Sampai akhir tahun 2023, Perseroan telah meluncurkan 5 (lima) super cluster yaitu Suvarna Padi, Suvarna Jati, Suvarna Padma, Suvarna Sari, dan Suvarna Respati yang secara keseluruhan berisi 29 sub-klaster dan lebih dari 8.000 unit rumah.

Alam Sutera development implements an ecological planning method, where the development must be adapted to the surrounding natural conditions, taking into account topographic, hydrological, access, and demographic factors. For the Company, the environmental concern is not merely a marketing strategy, but a priority that must be implemented consistently. Currently we are preparing Escala an area of 19-hectares of land, in which 5 hectares are dedicated for open green space. This year, Alam Sutera also launched the most exclusive cluster at Green Tunnel, namely The Gramercy.

## Suvarna Sutera Township

Suvarna Sutera is the Company's second township, located in Pasar Kemis, Tangerang, which has a development permit covering an area of 2,600 hectares and is 15 km away from Alam Sutera township. The township was designed by world-class urban planning designer from the United States, Sasaki, Walker \& Associates (SWA Group) and integrates residential, commercial, retail, and office areas to provide various conveniences for its citizens.



The development of Suvarna Sutera is divided into several phases, in which the first phase of development covers an area of 900 hectares. As of the end of 2023, the Company has launched 5 (five) super clusters, namely Suvarna Padi, Suvarna Jati, Suvarna Padma, Suvarna Sari, and Suvarna Respati, which in total contain 29 sub-clusters and more than 8,000 housing units.","![img-53.jpeg](img-53.jpeg)

## APARTEMEN DAN PERUMAHAN

Kami mengembangkan apartemen high-rise dan lowrise serta kompleks perumahan yang memiliki fasilitas lengkap dan nyaman bagi para penghuninya.

## EleVee Penthouses \& Residences

Berlokasi tepat di jantung CBD Alam Sutera, Elevee merupakan komplek apartemen dibangun di atas kawasan seluas 4 (empat) hektar. EleVee mengedepankan kenyamanan penghuninya dengan rancangan yang eksklusif serta memiliki lebih dari 40 fasilitas kelas dunia. Lingkungan EleVee dipastikan sangat aman dengan sistem keamanan berlapis, seperti boom gate, akses tower, akses elevator, akses unit, dan CCTV 24 jam.

Berada di sebelah EleVee, terdapat Forest Park yang sangat luas untuk sarana olahraga, bermain, dan rekreasi. EleVee juga memiliki pusat perbelanjaan untuk memenuhi kebutuhan penghuni, yaitu EleVee Promenade, yang terdiri dari ruko berlantai 2 dan 3. EleVee Promenade dirancang dengan konsep pencahayaan alami, udara segar, dan penghijauan yang asri.

## Ayodhya by Alam Sutera

Ayodhya by Alam Sutera is located in the heart of Tangerang, 6.2 km from Alam Sutera Township and 2.5 km to the Serpong Toll Gate (Jakarta-Merak Toll Road). In 2014, the first phase was launched, an apartment complex ayodhya residence with an apartment complex with 4 (four) 24-floor towers, namely Jade Tower, Coral Tower, Sienna Tower and Indigo Tower. Ayodhya by Alam Sutera also launched Ayodhya Square which is a shophouse and Ayodhya Garden which is a shophouse cluster. Ayodhya by Alam Sutera is surrounded by various facilities such as schools, universities, hospitals, places of worship, office centers, inter-city bus terminals and the Tangerang-Jakarta train station which will provide easy access for its residents.

## Mall @Alam Sutera

## Ruko

## III. COMMERCIAL AND RETAIL

The company sells retails unit and manages several commercial properties as supporting facilities for the township.

## Mall @Alam Sutera

Mall @Alam Sutera that was officially opened in 2012 comprising of three floors. This mall promotes a lifestyle concept, serving as an entertainment destination for families.

The multi-function hall that is integrated within the mall was completed in 2020 as part of our redevelopment. The venue, is furnished with the newest technology and has interior design strongly influenced by Indonesian culture, is used for a variety of shows, weddings, and Meeting, Incentive, Convention, Exhibition (MICE) events.

## Flavor Bliss

Flavor Bliss is a special icon of Alam Sutera, that serves as a center for family food and entertainment. Flavor Bliss is full with known outlets, including: Starbucks Coffee, Sushi Tei, Bandar Djakarta, and Total Buah Segar. Located at the entrance to the Alam Sutera area, Flavor Bliss stands on an area of 7.7 hectares. The Company develops Broadway in Flavor Bliss area, a spot that was inspired by the popular theater district in New York City, the United States.

## Pasar 8 \& Gudang T8

Pasar 8 is a modern market consisting of 149 shophouses, 238 kiosks, and 304 stall units. Since becoming operational in 2010, Pasar 8 has become the preferred place for shopping that provides a complete variety of needs for the community at economical prices. To support the activities of Pasar 8, we developed the T8 multifunctional warehouse, which provides 26 warehouse units and 16 lots around the Pasar 8 complex.

## Shophouses



The shophouses developed by the Company are strategically located along major arterial roads. Mall @Alam Sutera yang resmi dibuka tahun 2012, terdiri dari 3 (tiga) lantai. Mall ini mengusung konsep lifestyle dan berfungsi sebagai pusat hiburan bagi keluarga.

Multi function hall yang terintegrasi dengan mall telah diselesaikan pada tahun 2020 sebagai bagian dari upgrade pembangunan kami. Venue ini, dilengkapi dengan teknologi terbaru dan desain interior yang kental dengan nuansa Indonesia yang diperuntukkan untuk berbagai kegiatan Meeting, Incentive, Convention, Exhibition (MICE), pameran, pertunjukan, hingga pernikahan.

## Flavor Bliss

Flavor Bliss adalah salah satu ikon khusus di Alam Sutera yang menjadi pusat makanan dan hiburan keluarga. Flavor Bliss dipenuhi oleh gerai-gerai terkemuka, antara lain Starbucks Coffee, Sushi Tei, Bandar Djakarta, dan Total Buah Segar. Terletak di pintu masuk kawasan Alam Sutera, Flavor Bliss berdiri di atas lahan seluas 7,7 hektar. Perseroan mendirikan Broadway di area Flavor Bliss, sebuah spot yang terinspirasi oleh sebuah jalan yang sangat populer sebagai kawasan Theater District di kota New York, Amerika Serikat.

## Pasar 8 \& Gudang T8

Pasar 8 merupakan pasar modern yang terdiri dari 149 unit ruko, 238 unit kios, dan 304 unit lapak. Sejak beroperasi pada tahun 2010, Pasar 8 telah menjadi pilihan tempat berbelanja yang menyediakan berbagai kebutuhan lengkap bagi masyarakat dengan harga ekonomis. Guna mendukung kegiatan Pasar 8, kami mengembangkan gudang multifungsi T8, yang menyediakan 26 unit gudang dan 16 kavling di sekitar kompleks Pasar 8.

## Ruko

Ruko yang dibangun Perseroan terletak secara strategis di sepanjang jalan arteri utama. Menyadari tingginya minat pembeli, Perseroan meluncurkan beberapa ruko yang diantaranya adalah Ruko Ayodhya Square, Ruko Terrace 8, Ruko Terrace 9, Ruko Crystal 8, Victoria Lane, Woodlake, EleVee Promenade, dan Weston Lane untuk memenuhi kebutuhan tersebut.

## III. COMMERCIAL AND RETAIL

The company sells retails unit and manages several commercial properties as supporting facilities for the township.

## Mall @Alam Sutera

Mall @Alam Sutera that was officially opened in 2012 comprising of three floors. This mall promotes a lifestyle concept, serving as an entertainment destination for families.

The multi-function hall that is integrated within the mall was completed in 2020 as part of our redevelopment. The venue, is furnished with the newest technology and has interior design strongly influenced by Indonesian culture, is used for a variety of shows, weddings, and Meeting, Incentive, Convention, Exhibition (MICE) events.

## Flavor Bliss

Flavor Bliss is a special icon of Alam Sutera, that serves as a center for family food and entertainment. Flavor Bliss is full with known outlets, including: Starbucks Coffee, Sushi Tei, Bandar Djakarta, and Total Buah Segar. Located at the entrance to the Alam Sutera area, Flavor Bliss stands on an area of 7.7 hectares. The Company develops Broadway in Flavor Bliss area, a spot that was inspired by the popular theater district in New York City, the United States.

## Pasar 8 \& Gudang T8

Pasar 8 is a modern market consisting of 149 shophouses, 238 kiosks, and 304 stall units. Since becoming operational in 2010, Pasar 8 has become the preferred place for shopping that provides a complete variety of needs for the community at economical prices. To support the activities of Pasar 8, we developed the T8 multifunctional warehouse, which provides 26 warehouse units and 16 lots around the Pasar 8 complex.

## Shophouses

The shophouses developed by the Company are strategically located along major arterial roads. ### IV. TAMAN BUDAYA GARUDA WISNU KENCANA (GWK)

Taman budaya GWK adalah sebuah kawasan wisata berciri khas budaya dan nilai-nilai historis menyajikan pengalaman budaya Bali melalui beragam seni dan tari budaya Bali, dan menjadi rumah bagi monumen Garuda Wisnu Kencana yang tingginya mencapai 125 meter. Selain itu Taman GWK memiliki banyak daerah outdoor yang dapat digunakan untuk kegiatan liburan maupun event, antara lain plaza Wisnu, plaza Garuda, plaza Kura-kura, festival park, Lotus Pond dan Mandalaloka. Lotus Pond ini merupakan venue di GWK dengan luas 4.400 meter yang sering digunakan untuk event-event besar di Bali.

Kawasan ini memiliki luas 60 hektare dengan banyak fasilitas antara lain restoran, food court, amphitheater, cinema, dan tempat bermain outdoor. Jendela Bali The Panoramic Resto dan Beranda Resto merupakan Restoran yang memanjakan para pengunjung dengan kelezatan sajian kuliner Bali yang otentik. Amphitheather digunakan untuk mempertunjukkan seni dan tarian khas budaya Bali, Cinema menayangkan Garuda Cilik yang menceritakan filosofi GWK, dan tempat bermain outdoor yang memiliki beberapa macam permainan seperti fun wheels, trampoline, bouncing castle, dan scooter.

### IV. GARUDA WISNU KENCANA (GWK) CULTURAL PARK

GWK Cultural Park is a tourist area characterized by cultural and historical values, presenting Balinese cultural experiences through a variety of Balinese cultural arts and dances, and is home to the Garuda Wisnu Kencana monument which reaches 125 meters in height. Apart from that, GWK Park has many outdoor areas that can house holiday activities and events, including Wisnu Plaza, Garuda Plaza, Turtle Plaza, Festival Park, Lotus Pond and Mandalaloka. Lotus Pond is a venue at GWK with an area of 4,400 meters which is often used for large events in Bali.



The area expands around a 60-hectares of land with many facilities including restaurants, food court, amphitheater, cinema, and outdoor playground. Jendela Bali The Panoramic Resto and Beranda Resto indulge visitors with authentic Balinese culinary delights. The Amphitheather is a venue to show arts and dances typical of Balinese culture, the Cinema shows Garuda Cilik which tells the philosophy of GWK, and the outdoor playground has several kinds of games such as fun wheels, trampolines, bouncing castles and scooters.","![img-55.jpeg](img-55.jpeg)

### **INFORMASI KARYAWAN**

*Information on Employees*

**[SEOJK 2.e.12] [POJK C.3] [GRI 2-7]**

Pada tanggal 31 Desember 2023, karyawan Perseroan berjumlah 1.912 orang dengan rincian di bawah ini. Information About the Major and Controlling Shareholders

Hingga 31 Desember 2023, pemegang saham pengendali Perseroan adalah PT Manunggal Prime Development, PT Tangerang Fajar Industrial Estate, dan PT Argo Manunggal Land Development dengan kepemilikan saham masingmasing sebesar $23,84 \%, 25,72 \%$, dan $0,66 \%$. Pemilik manfaat akhir dari kepemilikan saham Perseroan adalah The Ning King dan keluarga. [SEOJK 2.e.16]

As of December 31, 2023, the Company's controlling shareholders are PT Manunggal Prime Development, PT Tangerang Fajar Industrial Estate, and PT Argo Manunggal Land Development, with respective shareholdings of $23.84 \%, 25.72 \%$, and $0.66 \%$. The ultimate beneficial owner of the Company's share ownership is The Ning King and family.

Chronology of Other Securities Listings

Surat Utang Senior 2025
Perseroan memiliki utang obligasi sebesar US\$251 juta yang akan jatuh tempo pada tahun 2025 dan telah dilunasi sebagian, sebesar US\$4,31 juta di di bulan Juni 2023. Sisa outstanding di akhir tahun 2023 adalah sebesar US\$246.697.000.

## Senior Notes 2025

The Company has senior notes of US\$251 million that will due in 2025 and has been partly repaid of US\$4.31 million in June 2023. The remaining outstanding at the end of 2023 was US\$246,697,000.

## AKUNTAN PUBLIK

Public Accountant

## Economic Overview

Ekonomi Indonesia pada tahun 2023 tumbuh sebesar 5,05\%, pertumbuhan ini sedikit lebih tinggi dari target awal 5.00\%. Pertumbuhan Indonesia masuk dalam 3 besar pertumbuhan ekonomi terbaik di ASEAN. Salah satu faktor pendukung pertumbuhan adalah investasi infrastruktur yang dapat menjadi katalis positif bagi kenaikan harga properti.

Di sisi keuangan, Pemerintah turut memberikan sentimen positif bagi industri properti melalui kebijakan fiskal dengan menerbitkan PMK 120/2023 tentang Pajak Pertambahan Nilai Ditanggung Pemerintah (PPN DTP)

Indonesia's economy in 2023 grew 5.05\%, this growth is slightly higher than the initial target of 5.00\%. Indonesia's growth is among the top 3 best economy growth in ASEAN. One of the deciding factor is investment in infrastrcuture which can be a positive catalyst for property price increase.

From the financial side, the Government is giving positive sentiment for the property industry as well thrue Fiscal Policy by issuing PMK 120/2023 about Government's Borne Value Added Tax (PPN DTP).

## TINJAUAN INDUSTRI

Industry Analysis

## TINJAUAN OPERASI PER SEGMEN USAHA

[SEOJK 2.f.1]
Pendapatan Alam Sutera berasal dari 2 (dua) sumber yaitu penjualan real estate dan pendapatan berulang. Pendapatan Alam Sutera secara keseluruhan di tahun 2023 adalah sebesar Rp3,96 triliun dengan rincian pendapatan real estate sebesar Rp3,19 triliun atau 81\% dari total Pendapatan dan pendapatan berulang sebesar Rp762,92 miliar atau 19\% dari total Pendapatan.

## Kavling Tanah

Pendapatan Perseroan dari penjualan kavling tanah pada tahun 2023 tercatat sebesar Rp674,11 miliar, turun dibandingkan tahun 2022 yang sebesar Rp1,63 triliun. Penurunan ini disebabkan tidak adanya penjualan tanah komersial yang signifikan pada tahun 2023.

## OPERATIONS REVIEW BY BUSSINESS SEGMENT

Alam Sutera revenues derives from two sources, namely real estate sales and recurring income. The total revenue of Alam sutera in 2023 was recorded at Rp 3.96 trillion with revenues from real estate were Rp 3.19 trillion or 81\% of the total Revenues and recurring income was recorded at Rp 762.92 billion or 19\% of the total Revenues.

## Land Lots

Pendapatan dari segmen rumah dan ruko tercatat sebesar Rp2,43 triliun meningkat sebesar 82,84\% jika dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya yang sebesar Rp1,33 triliun. Peningkatan ini didorong oleh bertambahnya serah terima rumah di kedua township yaitu Alam Sutera, terutama di Sutera Winona dan Suvarna Sutera. Peningkatan serah terima di Suvarna Sutera didukung oleh kebijakan insentif DTP PPN yang dikeluarkan oleh pemerintah.

## Apartemen

Di tahun 2023, pendapatan dari apartemen tercatat sebesar Rp78,90 miliar, lebih rendah dari pendapatan di tahun sebelumnya yaitu sebesar RP881,38 miliar. Penurunan ini terjadi karena Perseroan sudah mengakui sebagian besar penjualan unit apartemen Lloyd di tahun 2022.

## Gedung Perkantoran

Pendapatan dari penjualan gedung perkantoran adalah sebesar Rp13,66 miliar, meningkat dari Rp 4.13 miliar di tahun 2022. Hal ini disebabkan karena Perseroan berhasil menjual beberapa ruang perkantoran.

## Jasa Hospitality dan Prasarana

Pendapatan dari Jasa hospitality dan prasarana bertumbuh menjadi Rp 551,87 miliar di tahun 2023 dari Rp506,81 miliar di tahun sebelumnya. Hal ini disebabkan oleh peningkatan penerimaan luran Pemeliharaan Lingkungan (""IPL"") dari unit rumah dan apartemen seiring dengan penambahan jumlah penghuni.

## Houses and Shophouses

Revenues from houses and shophouses were recorded at Rp2.43 trillion. This has increased by $82.84 \%$ in comparison to the previous year's revenues, which were recorded at Rp1.33 trillion. This growth was driven by the increase of unit handed over in both Alam Sutera, especially Sutera Winona Cluster and Suvarna Sutera Township. The increase of hand over in Suvarna Sutera is supported by the free PPN policy that was issued by the Government.

## Apartments

In 2023, revenues from apartments were Rp78.90 billion, lower than previous year's sales at Rp881.38 billion. The decrease was because the Company has already recognized most of Lloyd Apartment sales in 2022.

## Office Buildings

The revenues from office buildings sales were Rp13.66 billion, an increase from Rp4.13 billion in 2022. This was because the Company had been able to sell some of the office spaces.

## Hospitality and Infrastructure Services



Revenues from hospitality and infrastructure increased to Rp551.87 billion in 2023 from Rp506.81 billion in the previous year. This was caused by the increase in the maintenance fee in both residential and apartments along with the occupancy growth.","## Rumah dan Ruko

Pendapatan dari segmen rumah dan ruko tercatat sebesar Rp2,43 triliun meningkat sebesar 82,84\% jika dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya yang sebesar Rp1,33 triliun. Peningkatan ini didorong oleh bertambahnya serah terima rumah di kedua township yaitu Alam Sutera, terutama di Sutera Winona dan Suvarna Sutera. Peningkatan serah terima di Suvarna Sutera didukung oleh kebijakan insentif DTP PPN yang dikeluarkan oleh pemerintah.

## Apartemen

Di tahun 2023, pendapatan dari apartemen tercatat sebesar Rp78,90 miliar, lebih rendah dari pendapatan di tahun sebelumnya yaitu sebesar RP881,38 miliar. Penurunan ini terjadi karena Perseroan sudah mengakui sebagian besar penjualan unit apartemen Lloyd di tahun 2022.

## Gedung Perkantoran

Pendapatan dari penjualan gedung perkantoran adalah sebesar Rp13,66 miliar, meningkat dari Rp 4.13 miliar di tahun 2022. Hal ini disebabkan karena Perseroan berhasil menjual beberapa ruang perkantoran.

## Jasa Hospitality dan Prasarana

Pendapatan dari Jasa hospitality dan prasarana bertumbuh menjadi Rp 551,87 miliar di tahun 2023 dari Rp506,81 miliar di tahun sebelumnya. Hal ini disebabkan oleh peningkatan penerimaan luran Pemeliharaan Lingkungan (""IPL"") dari unit rumah dan apartemen seiring dengan penambahan jumlah penghuni.

## Houses and Shophouses

Revenues from houses and shophouses were recorded at Rp2.43 trillion. This has increased by $82.84 \%$ in comparison to the previous year's revenues, which were recorded at Rp1.33 trillion. This growth was driven by the increase of unit handed over in both Alam Sutera, especially Sutera Winona Cluster and Suvarna Sutera Township. The increase of hand over in Suvarna Sutera is supported by the free PPN policy that was issued by the Government.

## Apartments

In 2023, revenues from apartments were Rp78.90 billion, lower than previous year's sales at Rp881.38 billion. The decrease was because the Company has already recognized most of Lloyd Apartment sales in 2022.

## Office Buildings

The revenues from office buildings sales were Rp13.66 billion, an increase from Rp4.13 billion in 2022. This was because the Company had been able to sell some of the office spaces.

## Aset Lancar

Pada 2023 aset lancar Perseroan menurun sebesar 20\% dari Rp 3,64 triliun menjadi Rp 2,91 triliun. Penurunan terbesar terjadi pada persediaan lancar yang menurun dari Rp1,18 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp774,75 miliar di akhir 2023.

## Aset Tidak Lancar

Aset tidak lancar Perseroan meningkat sebesar 4\% dari Rp18,66 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp 19,33 triliun di tahun 2023. Kenaikan yang signifikan terjadi pada persediaan yaitu meningkat sebesar $14 \%$ dari Rp 3,79 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp4,33 triliun di tahun 2023. Hal ini seiring dengan penyelesaian produk yang akan diserahterimakan ke pelanggan dalam waktu lebih dari satu tahun.

## Total Aset

Total aset Perseroan pada 31 Desember 2023 tercatat sebesar Rp22,24 triliun. Angka ini cenderung tidak mengalami perubahan jika dibandingkan dengan total asset di tahun 2022 yaitu sebesar Rp 22,30 triliun.

## Liabilitas Jangka Pendek

Liabilitas jangka pendek Perseroan pada akhir tahun 2023 tercatat sebesar Rp 3,69 triliun. Angka ini cenderung tidak mengalami perubahan jika dibandingkan dengan total liabilitas jangka pendek di tahun 2022 yaitu sebesar Rp 3,72 triliun.

## Current Assets

Current assets decreased by 20\% y-o-y from Rp 3.64 trillion to Rp 2.91 trillion. The decrease primarily occurred in current inventories that decreased from Rp 1.18 trillion in 2022 to Rp 774.75 billion in 2023.

## Non-current Assets

Non-current assets increased by $4 \%$ from IDR 18.66 trillion in 2022 to IDR 19.33 trillion in 2023. The significant increase was seen in inventories, with a $14 \%$ increase from Rp 3.79 trillion in 2022 to IDR 4.33 trillion in 2023. This was in line with the products completion that will be handed over to the customers in more than one year period.

## Total Assets

Total assets of the Company as of December 31, 2023 was recorded at Rp 22.24 trillion. The number slightly unchanged if compared to total assets in 2022 which were Rp22.30 trillion.

## Current Liabilities



The Company's current liabilities as of the end of 2023 were recorded at Rp 3,69 triliun. Pada 2023 aset lancar Perseroan menurun sebesar 20\% dari Rp 3,64 triliun menjadi Rp 2,91 triliun. Penurunan terbesar terjadi pada persediaan lancar yang menurun dari Rp1,18 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp774,75 miliar di akhir 2023.

## Aset Tidak Lancar

Aset tidak lancar Perseroan meningkat sebesar 4\% dari Rp18,66 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp 19,33 triliun di tahun 2023. Kenaikan yang signifikan terjadi pada persediaan yaitu meningkat sebesar $14 \%$ dari Rp 3,79 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp4,33 triliun di tahun 2023. Hal ini seiring dengan penyelesaian produk yang akan diserahterimakan ke pelanggan dalam waktu lebih dari satu tahun.

## Total Aset

Total aset Perseroan pada 31 Desember 2023 tercatat sebesar Rp22,24 triliun. Angka ini cenderung tidak mengalami perubahan jika dibandingkan dengan total asset di tahun 2022 yaitu sebesar Rp 22,30 triliun.

## Liabilitas Jangka Pendek

Liabilitas jangka pendek Perseroan pada akhir tahun 2023 tercatat sebesar Rp 3,69 triliun. Angka ini cenderung tidak mengalami perubahan jika dibandingkan dengan total liabilitas jangka pendek di tahun 2022 yaitu sebesar Rp 3,72 triliun.

## Current Assets

Current assets decreased by 20\% y-o-y from Rp 3.64 trillion to Rp 2.91 trillion. The decrease primarily occurred in current inventories that decreased from Rp 1.18 trillion in 2022 to Rp 774.75 billion in 2023.

## Non-current Assets

Non-current assets increased by $4 \%$ from IDR 18.66 trillion in 2022 to IDR 19.33 trillion in 2023. The significant increase was seen in inventories, with a $14 \%$ increase from Rp 3.79 trillion in 2022 to IDR 4.33 trillion in 2023. This was in line with the products completion that will be handed over to the customers in more than one year period.

## Total Assets

Total assets of the Company as of December 31, 2023 was recorded at Rp 22.24 trillion. The number slightly unchanged if compared to total assets in 2022 which were Rp22.30 trillion.

The Company's current liabilities as of the end of 2023 were recorded at Rp 3,69 triliun. ## Arus Kas dari Aktivitas Investasi

Penggunaan kas untuk aktivitas investasi berkurang sebesar $51 \%$ dari Rp610,46 miliar di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp301,28 miliar di tahun 2023. Hal ini dikarenakan pada tahun 2023 Perseroan mencairkan beberapa deposito.

## Arus Kas dari Aktivitas Pendanaan

Penggunaan arus kas untuk kegiatan aktivitas pendanaan Perseroan tercatat sebesar Rp976,81 miliar atau turun sebesar $33 \%$ jika dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelumnya yang sebesar Rp1,47 triliun. Penurunan ini terjadi karena di tahun 2023 perusahaan melakukan pembayaran dipercepat Obligasi dengan jumlah yang lebih sedikit dibandingkan di tahun 2022.

## Kas dan Setara Kas

Per 31 Desember 2023, posisi kas dan setara kas Perseroan mengalami penurunan sebesar $18 \%$ dari Rp1,44 triliun di tahun 2022 menjadi Rp1,18 triliun di tahun 2023.

## KEMAMPUAN MEMBAYAR UTANG DAN TINGKAT KOLEKTIBILITAS PIUTANG

## Kemampuan Membayar Utang

[SEOJK 2.f.3]
Kemampuan Perseroan dalam membayar kewajibannya tercermin melalui rasio-rasio di bawah ini:

## Cash Flow from Investing Activities

Cash uses from investing activities decreased 51\% from Rp610.46 billion in 2022 to Rp301.28 billion in 2023. This was because in 2023 the company has liquidated a few of its deposits.

## Cash Flow from Financing Activities

Cash outflow from financing activities were recorded at Rp 976.81 billion or decreased by $33 \%$ compared to the previous year amounting Rp 1.47 trillion. This decline was because in 2023 the company prepaid back a smaller portion of its Notes compared to the year 2022.

## Cash and Cash Equivalents

As of December 31, 2023, the Company recorded a net decrease of cash and cash equivalent of $18 \%$ from Rp 1.44 trillion in 2022 to Rp1.18 trillion in 2023.

Management Discussion and Analysis

## DIVIDEN

## [SEOJK 2.f.13]

Perseroan melakukan pembayaran dividen sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan, yaitu melalui persetujuan pemegang saham dalam RUPS Tahunan berdasarkan usulan Direksi. Sesuai dengan prospektus Perseroan, Direksi telah mengusulkan pembagian dividen untuk dilakukan secara progresif, dengan rincian sebagai berikut:

## DIVIDENDS

The Company pays dividends in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as the Company's Articles of Association, i.e., through shareholder approval at the Annual GMS based on the Board of Directors' recommendation. According to the Company's prospectus, the Board of Directors has proposed that dividends be distributed progressively, with the following details:

| Laba Bawah Setelah Pajak <br> Net Profit After Tax | Dividen Tuani <br> Cash Dividend |
| :-- | :--: |
| Sampai dengan Rp150.000.000.000 pertama <br> Up to the first Rp150,000,000,000 | $20 \%$ |
| Lebih dari Rp150.000.000.000 <br> Over Rp150,000,000,000 | $30 \%$ |

Dengan pertimbangan kondisi keuangan dan bisnis serta melalui persetujuan RUPS Tahunan, Perseroan tidak membagikan dividen dalam 2 tahun terakhir.

## PERUBAHAN PERATURAN

[SEOJK 2.f.16]
Menjelang akhir tahun 2023, Pemerintah menerbitkan Peraturan Menteri Keuangan (PMK) nomor 120/2023 tentang Pajak Pertambahan Nilai atas Rumah Tapak dan Satuan Rumah Susun yang Ditanggung Pemerintah (PPN DTP) Tahun Anggaran 2023. Penerbitan peraturan ini memberikan dampak positif kepada keputusan pembelian rumah khususnya dengan harga jual di bawah Rp5 miliar.

## PERUBAHAN KEBIJAKAN AKUNTANSI

[SEOJK 2.f.17]
Efektif tanggal 1 Januari 2023, Perseroan menerapkan amandemen dan penyesuaian atas Pernyataan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan (PSAK) yang tidak berdampak material terhadap kinerja, yaitu:

- Amendemen PSAK No. 1 ""Penyajian Laporan Keuangan"" tentang Klasifikasi Liabilitas sebagai Jangka Pendek atau Jangka Panjang.
- Amendemen PSAK No. 1 ""Penyajian Laporan Keuangan"" tentang Pengungkapan Kebijakan Akuntansi.

With a consideration in the financial and business conditions and after an approval by the Annual GMS, the Company has not distributed dividends in the past 2 years.

## CHANGES IN REGULATIONS

Towards the end of 2023, the Government issued Regulations of Ministry of Finance (PMK) no. 120/2023 regarding Value-Added Tax on Landed Houses and Flats Borne by the Government (PPN DTP) for Fiscal Year 2023. The issuance of the regulation makes positive impacts to the decision to purchase homes, especially with a selling price below Rp5 billion.

## CHANGES IN ACCOUNTING POLICIES

Effective on January 1, 2023, the Company implemented amendments and improvements of Statements of Financial Accounting Standards (SFAS) without material impacts on its performance, namely:

- Amendments to SFAS No. 1 ""Presentation of Financial Statements"" about the Classification of Liabilities as a Current or Non-Current.


- Amendments to SFAS No. 1 ""Presentation of Financial Statements"" about the Disclosure of Accounting Policies.","# Analisis Dan Pembahasan Manajemen 

Management Discussion and Analysis

## DIVIDEN

## [SEOJK 2.f.13]

Perseroan melakukan pembayaran dividen sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan, yaitu melalui persetujuan pemegang saham dalam RUPS Tahunan berdasarkan usulan Direksi. Sesuai dengan prospektus Perseroan, Direksi telah mengusulkan pembagian dividen untuk dilakukan secara progresif, dengan rincian sebagai berikut:

## DIVIDENDS

The Company pays dividends in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as the Company's Articles of Association, i.e., through shareholder approval at the Annual GMS based on the Board of Directors' recommendation. According to the Company's prospectus, the Board of Directors has proposed that dividends be distributed progressively, with the following details:

| Laba Bawah Setelah Pajak <br> Net Profit After Tax | Dividen Tuani <br> Cash Dividend |
| :-- | :--: |
| Sampai dengan Rp150.000.000.000 pertama <br> Up to the first Rp150,000,000,000 | $20 \%$ |
| Lebih dari Rp150.000.000.000 <br> Over Rp150,000,000,000 | $30 \%$ |

Dengan pertimbangan kondisi keuangan dan bisnis serta melalui persetujuan RUPS Tahunan, Perseroan tidak membagikan dividen dalam 2 tahun terakhir.

## Target and Projection in 2024

## PROSPEK USAHA

[SEOJK 2.f.9]
Hunian yang layak, aman dan nyaman masih sangat dibutuhkan oleh penduduk Indonesia, terutama hunian yang dekat dengan berbagai fasilitas, seperti pusat perbelanjaan dan perkantoran. Saat ini, backlog kepemilikan atas perumahan di Indonesia diperkirakan sebesar 12,7 juta unit, maka bisnis properti masih menjadi industri sangat menjanjikan .

Dorongan positif diperkirakan akan berasal dari Bank Indonesia yang akan menahan suku bunga acuan untuk tidak naik dan kemungkinan menurunkannya seiring dengan The Fed yang akan memangkas suku bunga acuan setelah kondisi membaik.

## STRATEGI PEMASARAN DAN PROMOSI

[SEOJK 2.f.12]
Perseroan terus berinovasi untuk mengembangkan produk-produk yang unik, fungsional dan berkarakter agar bisnis dapat terus bertumbuh secara berkelanjutan. Strategi kami terbukti dari tingginya serapan properti Perseroan oleh loyal customer. Melalui testimonial mereka, Perseroan mendapat dorongan untuk memperluas pasar sehingga kami memperluas jaringan ke daerah diluar Tangerang, yaitu Sawangan, dan sukses.

Strategi pemasaran produk Perseroan dilakukan melalui berbagai cara, antara lain pemasangan billboard dan banners di lokasi-lokasi strategis, pembangunan show unit, dan Alam Sutera Expo yang diadakan di Mall @Alam Sutera.

Perseroan juga aktif melakukan promosi dan pemasaran melalui media sosial. Informasi terkini dari proyek-proyek kami dapat diakses di:
IG: @alam_sutera_realty
Website: www.alamsuterarealty.co.id.

## BUSINESS PROSPECT

Proper, safe and comfortable housing was still very much needed by the Indonesian population, especially housing that is close to various facilities, such as shopping centers and offices. Currently, the backlog of housing ownership in Indonesia was estimated at 12.7 million units, so property business is still a very promising industry.

Positive encouragement is expected to come from Bank Indonesia which will hold interest rates from rising with the possibility of declining the rates in line with The Fed cutting interest rates after conditions improve.

## MARKETING AND PROMOTIONAL STRATEGY

The Company always innovates to develop products that are unique, functional and characterful to ensure a sustainable business growth. Our strategy is proven by the high demand from our loyal customers. From their testimony, the company is encouraged to expand our market so we expanded our network to area outside of Tangerang, which is Sawangan, and it was successful.

The Company's marketing strategy involves using many channels, amoung them are putting billboards and banners in strategic locations, presents show units, and Alam Sutera Expo at Mall @Alam Sutera.

The Company also actively promotes and conducts marketing campaign through social media. Updated information about our projects can be accessed at: IG: @alam_sutera_realty

Good Corporate Governance

Perseroan berupaya menerapkan praktik tata kelola perusahaan yang baik dalam menjalankan seluruh kegiatan usahanya. Praktik ini diterapkan oleh seluruh jajaran manajemen dan karyawan berlandaskan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, termasuk namun tidak terbatas pada:

1. UU No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perusahaan Terbatas (UUPT),
2. Pedoman Umum GCG oleh Komite Nasional Kebijakan Governansi,
3. Peraturan OJK, dan
4. Peraturan BEI.

Perseroan dalam praktik GCG, senantiasa berpedoman pada 5 (lima) prinsip dasar yaitu transparansi, akuntabilitas, tanggung jawab, independensi, dan kewajaran.

The Company strives to implement good corporate governance in its business activities. These practices are implemented by the management and employees based on applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to:

1. Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies (LUPT),
2. General Guidelines for GCG by the National Governance Policy Committee,
3. OJK Regulations, and
4. IDX Regulations.

The Company's GCG practices are based on 5 (five) basic principles, which are transparency, accountability, responsibility, independence, and fairness.

## General Meeting of Shareholders

[SEOJK 2.g.1]

Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS) adalah forum tertinggi bagi para pemegang saham untuk mengambil keputusan yang berkaitan dengan kepentingan Perseroan. Hak dan wewenang RUPS sesuai dengan UU dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan adalah:

1. Menerima dan mengesahkan Laporan Tahunan Perseroan
2. Menentukan penggunaan laba Perseroan, termasuk pembagian dividen kepada pemegang saham
3. Mengangkat dan memberhentikan anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau Direksi
4. Menyetujui aksi korporasi penting/material.

## RUPS Tahunan 2023

RUPS Tahunan diadakan pada Selasa, 6 Juni 2023 di Synergy Building lantai 21, Jl. Jalur Sutera Barat 17, Alam Sutera, Tangerang 15143, Banten, dan dilaksanakan secara hybrid (offline dan online secara bersamaan).

Jumlah saham yang hadir atau diwakili dalam RUPS Tahunan sebanyak 12.575 .125 .413 saham yang merupakan $63,997 \%$ dari total sebanyak 19.649 .411 .888 saham dengan hak suara yang sah yang telah dikeluarkan oleh Perseroan.

Keputusan RUPS diambil dengan cara pemungutan suara secara elektronik dan fisik setelah para pemegang saham diberikan kesempatan untuk mengajukan pertanyaan atau pendapat. Penghitungan kehadiran dan persetujuan dilakukan oleh pihak independen yaitu Biro Administrasi Efek PT Raya Saham Registra dan disahkan secara Notaril. [SEOJK 2.g.1b]

Berikut adalah risalah RUPS Tahunan 2023.

The General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) is the highest decision-making forum for shareholders to address the Company's interests. The rights and authorities of the GMS according to the law and the Articles of Associations are:

1. Receiving and ratifying the Company's Annual Report
2. Determining the use of the Company's profits, including the distribution of dividends to shareholders
3. Appointing and dismissing members of the Board of Commissioners and/or the Board of Directors
4. Approving important/material corporate actions.

## 2023 Annual GMS

Annual GMS was held on Tuesday, June 6, 2023 at Synergy Building 21th floor, Jl. Jalur Sutera Barat 17, Alam Sutera, Tangerang 15143, Banten, and held in hybrid format (both offline and online at the same time).

The shareholders of the Company attended or represented in the Meeting was $12,575,125,413$ shares, which are $63.997 \%$ from total of $19,649,411,888$ shares, which have been issued by the Company.

Resolutions of the GMS were passed through electronically and physical voting after the shareholders were given opportunities to raise questions or give opinions. The calculation of attendance and voting are done by an independent party, namely Share Registrar PT Raya Saham Registra and notarial authorized.

Perseroan telah memberikan informasi kepada pemegang saham RUPS Tahunan melalui keterbukaan informasi sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan peraturan OJK No.15/POJK.04/2020 tentang Rencana dan Penyelenggaraan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham perusahaan terbuka, yang diumumkan melalui situs web Bursa Efek Indonesia (www.idx.co.id), situs web Perseroan (www.alamsuterarealty.co.id), dan situs web penyedia jasa e-RUPS eASY KSEI, dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris, berikut ini:

1. Pengumuman Rencana RUPS pada tanggal 30 April 2023
2. Pemanggilan RUPS Tahunan pada tanggal 15 Mei 2023
3. Ringkasan Risalah RUPS Tahunan pada tanggal 8 Juni 2023.
4. Risalah RUPS pada tanggal 3 Juli 2023

Materi Rapat telah disediakan melalui situs website Perseroan dan eASY KSEI pada saat pemanggilan tanggal 15 Mei 2023.

## RUPS Tahunan 2022

RUPS Tahunan 2022 diselenggarakan pada 29 Juni 2022 bertempat di Synergy Building Lantai 21, Jl. Jalur Sutera Barat 17, Alam Sutera, Tangerang 15143. Hak suara yang sah yang hadir atau diwakili dalam Rapat adalah 14.126.319.849 saham atau $71,892 \%$

Keputusan RUPS Tahunan 2022 adalah:

1. Menerima dengan baik dan menyetujui Laporan Tahunan dan Laporan Keuangan Perseroan termasuk Laporan Tugas Pengawasan yang telah dilaksanakan Dewan Komisaris untuk tahun buku yang berakhir pada tanggal 31 Desember 2021 serta memberikan pelunasan dan pembebasan sepenuhnya (acquit et de charge) kepada Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris Perseroan atas tindakan pengurusan dan pengawasan yang telah dilakukan, sejauh tindakan tersebut tercermin dalam Laporan Tahunan dan Laporan Keuangan Perseroan.
2. Menetapkan penggunaan Laba Bersih Perseroan untuk Tahun Buku yang berakhir pada tanggal 31 Desember 2021 sebesar Rp150.000.000.000, (Seratus Lima Puluh Miliar Rupiah) dengan perincian sebagai berikut:

## Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Good Corporate Governance

## Information Disclosure Related to GMS

The Company has provided information to the shareholders on the Annual GMS through information disclosure in accordance to the Company's Articles of Association and OJK regulation No.15/POJK.04/2020 regarding the Plan and Implementation of General Meetings of Shareholders of publicly listed companies, that was announced on Indonesia Stock Exchange website (www.idx.co.id), the Company's website (www. alamsuterarealty.co.id), and e-RUPS eASY KSEI service provider's website, in Indonesia and English, as follows:

1. Announcement of GMS on April 30, 2023, on IDX and KSEI websites.

## Board of Directors

Direksi berwenang dan bertanggung jawab penuh atas pengurusan Perseroan untuk kepentingan Perseroan, sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan serta mewakili Perseroan, baik di dalam maupun di luar pengadilan sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

Direksi memiliki Pedoman Kerja Direksi (The Board of Directors' Charter) yang berfungsi sebagai panduan utama Direksi dalam melakukan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Pedoman Kerja ini disusun berdasarkan prinsipprinsip hukum korporasi, ketentuan Anggaran Dasar, peraturan dan ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, arahan pemegang saham, serta praktik-praktik terbaik tata kelola Perusahaan. [SEOJK 2.g.2b]

## Pengangkatan dan Pemberhentian

Penentuan masa jabatan, pengangkatan dan pemberhentian Direksi merupakan wewenang RUPS. Direksi Perseroan diangkat oleh RUPS untuk masa jabatan 2 (dua) tahun dan dapat diangkat kembali. Pengangkatan dilakukan melalui proses pencalonan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

[SEOJK 2.g.2a]

1. Bertanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan untuk kepentingan Perseroan dan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan.
2. Wajib beritikad baik dan bertanggung jawab dalam melakukan pengurusan dalam Perseroan.
3. Wajib mewakili Perseroan baik di luar maupun di dalam pengadilan.
4. Wajib membuat dan memelihara daftar pemegang saham, risalah RUPS, dan risalah rapat direksi, menyelenggarakan pembukuan Perseroan, melaporkan kepemilikan sahamnya.

The Board of Directors has the authority and full responsibility for managing the Company for the interests of the Company, in accordance with the purposes and objectives of the Company and representing the Company, both in and out of court, in accordance with the provisions of the Company's Articles of Association.

The Board of Directors has The Board of Directors' Charter that serves as the main guide for The Board of Directors in carrying out its roles and responsibilities. The Charter are based on principles of corporate law, provisions of the Articles of Association, applicable regulations and legislation, shareholder directives, as well as best practices in corporate governance.

## Appointment and Dismissal

The determination of the term of office, appointment, and dismissal of The Board of Directors is under the authority of the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS). The Company's Directors are appointed by the GMS for a term of 2 (two) years and may be reappointed. The appointment is made through a nomination process in accordance with applicable laws and the Company's Articles of Association.

## Roles and Responsibilities

1. Responsible for managing the Company for the benefit of the Company and in accordance with the purposes and objectives of the Company.
2. Obligated to act in good faith and be responsible in managing the Company.
3. Required to represent the Company both inside and outside the court.

As of December 31, 2023, the Board of Directors does not have a committee under them. But they are assisted by the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit.

The Board of Directors assesses that the performance of both the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit in 2023 are good. The assessment was based on many criteria, including meetings attendance, competency development and achievement of the unit's performance target.

## Board of Commissioners

Dewan Komisaris mewakili pemegang saham dan para pemangku kepentingan Perseroan, bertugas melakukan pengawasan atas kebijakan pengurusan, jalannya pengurusan pada umumnya, baik mengenai Perseroan maupun usaha Perseroan, serta memberi nasihat kepada Direksi. Pengawasan dan pemberian nasihat dilakukan untuk kepentingan Perseroan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan. [GRI 2-12]

## Pengangkatan dan Pemberhentian

Dewan Komisaris diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh RUPS. Pengangkatan dilakukan melalui proses pencalonan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan. Dewan Komisaris diangkat oleh RUPS untuk masa jabatan 2 (dua) tahun dan dapat diangkat kembali.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

[SEOJK 2.g.3a]
Sesuai dengan Pedoman Kerja Dewan Komisaris, Dewan Komisaris secara kolektif memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab, yang mencakup: [SEOJK 2.g.3b]

1. Mengawasi dan bertanggung jawab atas pengawasan terhadap kebijakan, pengurusan, jalannya pengurusan pada umumnya, baik mengenai Perseroan maupun usaha Perseroan dan memberi nasihat kepada Direksi.
2. Memberikan arahan terhadap kebijakan, strategi, dan proses pengambilan keputusan Direksi dalam menjalankan Perseroan.
3. Membentuk Komite Audit dan komite lainnya dalam rangka mendukung efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris.
4. Melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian.
5. Melakukan evaluasi terhadap kinerja komite yang membantu pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya.

The Board of Commissioners represents the shareholders and other stakeholders of the Company, is responsible for overseeing management policies, overall management, both pertaining to the Company as well as the Company's business, along with providing advice to the Board of Directors. The oversight and advisory function is carried out in the Company's interest and in accordance with the Company's purpose and objectives.

## Appointment and Termination

The members of the Board of Commissioners members are appointed and terminated by the GMS. The appointments are carried out through a nomination process in accordance with the prevailing rules and regulations, as well as the Company's Articles of Association. The members of the Board of Commissioners are appointed by the GMS for a tenure of 2 (two) years and may be reappointed.

## Duties and Responsibilities

According to the Charter of the Board of Commissioners, the Board collectively has duties and responsibilities including:

1. Overseeing and responsible for the supervision of policies, management, general management, both regarding the Company and the Company's business and advising The Board of Directors.
2. Provide guidance regarding policies, strategy, and decision-making process for the Board of Directors in terms of the Company's management.
3. Forming the Audit Committee and other committees to support the Board of Commissioners in fulfilling its role and responsibilities effectively.
4. Carrying out roles and responsibilities in good faith and with prudence.


5. Evaluate the committee's performance to assist with its role and responsibilities.","# DEWAN KOMISARIS

## Komisaris Independen

Perseroan memiliki 2 (dua) orang komisaris independen, sehingga perbandingannya adalah $40 \%$ dari jumlah seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris dan memenuhi standar 30\% yang ditentukan oleh POJK No. 33/2014.

Kriteria komisaris independen Perseroan adalah:

1. Tidak bekerja untuk Perseroan atau memiliki wewenang dan tanggung jawab untuk merencanakan, memimpin, mengendalikan atau mengawasi usaha Perseroan dalam 6 (enam) bulan terakhir, kecuali untuk pengangkatan kembali sebagai Komisaris Independen pada periode selanjutnya;
2. Tidak memiliki saham apapun baik langsung atau tidak langsung dalam Perseroan;
3. Tidak memiliki hubungan afiliasi dengan Perseroan, anggota Dewan Komisaris, Direksi atau pemegang saham utama Perseroan. Afiliasi dimaksud mencakup tidak adanya hubungan keluarga sedarah sampai derajat ketiga baik menurut garis lurus maupun garis ke samping atau hubungan pribadi lainnya;
4. Tidak memiliki usaha baik langsung maupun tidak langsung yang berhubungan dengan usaha Perseroan.
5. Oversee the effectiveness of the GCG practices and provide advice to improve GCG system and implementation.
6. Convene the Annual GMS and other GMS in accordance with rules and regulations, as well as the Company's Articles of Association.

In conducting their duties and responsibilities, the Board has full access to all reports and information, and is authorized to receive clarifications in relation to these reports and information. The Board of Commissioners is also authorized to temporarily suspend one or more members of the Board of Directors if they are found to engage in actions that is contrary to the articles of Association and/or the prevailing rules and regulations.

To avoid conflict of interests, the Board of Commissioners does not directly manage the Company.

## Independent Commissioners

The Company has 2 (two) independent commissioners, making up $40 \%$ of the total members of the Board of Commissioners and fullfill the 30\% standard determined by POJK No. 33/2014.

The Company's criteria for independent commissioners are:

1. Has not worked for the Company or have been authorized and responsible for planning, leading, controlling or overseeing the Company's business within the last 6 (six) months, except for reappointment as an Independent Commissioner in the successive period;
2. Does not own, either directly or indirectly, any shares in the Company;
3. Does not have any affiliated relations with the Company, the members of the Board of Commissioners, The Board of Directors or the Company's major shareholders. The said affiliation includes the absence of blood relatives up to the third degree, both in a direct line and a collateral line or other personal relationship;


4. Does not have any business, either directly or indirectly, related to the Company's business.","6. Memantau efektivitas praktik GCG serta memberikan saran-saran perbaikan sistem dan implementasi GCG.

## Rapat

## [SEOJK 2.g.3c]

Dewan Komisaris wajib menyelenggarakan rapat berkala sekurang-kurangnya 1 (satu) kali setiap 2 (dua) bulan, kecuali apabila dipandang perlu oleh seorang atau lebih anggota Dewan Komisaris melalui permintaan tertulis dari seorang atau lebih anggota Dewan Komisaris atau atas permintaan tertulis dari 1 (satu) orang atau lebih pemegang saham yang secara bersama-sama mewakili $1 / 10$ (satu per sepuluh) atau lebih dari jumlah seluruh saham dengan hak suara.

Dewan Komisaris juga wajib menghadiri rapat gabungan dengan Direksi. Setiap keputusan dalam rapat dituangkan ke dalam risalah rapat, termasuk dalam hal terjadi perbedaan pendapat (dissenting opinion) dan didokumentasikan dengan baik.

Berikut adalah tingkat kehadiran anggota Dewan Komisaris di dalam rapat internal Dewan Komisaris, rapat gabungan dengan Direksi dan RUPS.

## Meetings

The Board of Commissioners is required to hold regular meetings at least once every 2 (two) months, unless deemed necessary by one or more members of the Board of Commissioners by a written request from one or more members of the Board of Commissioners or at the written request of 1 (one) or more shareholders that collectively represent $1 / 10$ (one tenth) or more of all shares with voting rights.

The Board of Commissioners must also attend the joint meetings with the Board of Directors. Every decision taken at the meeting is recorded in the minutes of meeting, including in the event of dissenting opinion, and is properly documented.

Good Corporate Governance

## Evaluasi Direksi

[SEOJK 2.g.3e]
Dewan Komisaris menilai kinerja Direksi pada tahun 2023 baik. Penilaian ini didasarkan kepada penilaian kinerja Direksi sesuai prosedur yang dapat ditemukan pada bagian Nominasi dan Remunerasi Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris pada Laporan Tahunan dan Keberlanjutan ini.

## Evaluasi Komite di Bawah Dewan Komisaris [SEOJK 2.g.3f]

Dewan Komisaris telah membentuk 2 (dua) komite untuk membantu pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya, yaitu Komite Audit dan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi.

Dewan Komisaris secara berkala menilai dan mengevaluasi kinerja kedua komite ini dengan mempertimbangkan kualitas rekomendasi pengawasan yang diberikan, pemenuhan kewajiban pelaporan, kehadiran rapat, serta kriteria penilaian yang tercantum dalam KPI. Sepanjang 2023, Dewan Komisaris menilai bahwa kedua komite telah menjalankan tugas dengan baik, dan menyampaikan laporan kepada Dewan Komisaris secara komprehensif dan tepat waktu.

## Keberagaman Komposisi

Saat ini, Perseroan belum memiliki kebijakan khusus terkait keberagaman komposisi Dewan Komisaris. Akan tetapi setiap anggota Dewan Komisaris memiliki beragam latar belakang dan kompetensi yang mampu mewakili berbagai kelompok pemangku kepentingan.

## Evaluation of The Board of Directors

The Board of Commissioners acknowledge the performance of the Board of Directors in 2023 was good. The assessment was based on the Board of Directors' performance assessment according to the procedures that can be found in the Nomination and Remuneration of the Board of Directors and Commissioners in this Annual and Sustainability Report.

## Evaluation of the Committees under the Board of Commissioners

The Board of Commissioners had established 2 (two) committees to assist in their duties and responsibility, namely Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

The Board of Commissioners periodically assess and evaluate the performance of these two committees by taking into consideration the quality of supervisory recommendations provided, fulfillment of reporting obligations, meeting attendance, as well as assessment criteria listed in the KPI. Throughout 2023, the Board of Commissioners assessed that both committees have carried out their duties satisfactorily, and submitted reports to the Board of Commissioners in a comprehensive and timely manner.

## Diversity in Composition



Currently, the Company does not have any particular policy related to diversity in composition of the Board of Commissioners. However, all members of the Board of Commissioners has multiple backgrounds and competencies that are able to represent many groups of stakeholders.","# Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

### **Kebijakan Penilaian Kinerja Direksi**

**[GRI 2-18]**

Perseroan melakukan penilaian kinerja secara rutin terhadap Direksi secara internal. Untuk mempertahankan kinerja yang optimal, Perseroan melakukan penilaian kinerja anggota Direksi dengan menggunakan *Corporate Balance Scorecard* dan *Activity Plan Monitoring* yang dilengkapi dengan *Problem Identification and Corrective Action* (PICA).

Evaluasi hasil penilaian ini akan dilakukan oleh Direktur Utama setiap bulan. Kinerja Direksi secara keseluruhan akan dievaluasi oleh Dewan Komisaris setiap 3 (tiga) bulan, di mana masing-masing anggota Direksi akan

### *Policy on Performance Assessment of The Board of Directors*

The Company presently carries out routine performance assessment of the Board of Directors by internal. To maintain optimum performance, the Company evaluates the performance of the members of The Board of Directors by using a Corporate Balance Scorecard and Activity Plan Monitoring that includes Problem Identification and Corrective Action (PICA).



The evaluation of these assessment results will be conducted by the President Director on a monthly basis. The overall performance of The Board of Directors is evaluated by the Board of Commissioners every 3 (three)","# Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Penilaian kinerja terhadap Direktur Utama menggunakan metode yang sama untuk dievaluasi oleh Komisaris Utama setiap 3 (tiga) bulan sekali.

Penilaian terhadap kinerja Direktur mempertimbangkan sejumlah kriteria, antara lain: months, such that each member of the Board of Directors receive a Performance Management Report every 6 (six) months that serves as the benchmark for their annual assessment. ## Kebijakan Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris [GRI 2-18]

Prosedur penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan secara berkala melalui evaluasi dan penilaian setiap tahunnya oleh Pemegang Saham melalui mekanisme RUPS dengan memperhatikan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar serta regulasi yang berlaku. Penilaian terhadap kinerja Dewan Komisaris mempertimbangkan sejumlah kriteria, antara lain tingkat kehadiran rapat baik secara internal dan bersama Direksi serta kinerja Perseroan secara keseluruhan. Penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan secara mandiri oleh pemegang saham Perseroan dalam RUPS Tahunan.

In addition, the criteria for performance assessment of the Board of Directors also covers other aspects included in the KPI scorecard of the Board of Directors, among others the achievement of the Company's financial performance and cash flow conditions, sales achievement, collectability level, achievement of recurring income, and the potential of new products already launched by the Company in the current year.

## Policy on Performance Assessment of the Board of Commissioners



The procedure for assessing the performance of the Board of Commissioners is conducted periodically through an annual evaluation and assessment by the Shareholders through the GMS, taking into account the provisions of the Articles of Association and applicable regulations. The assessment of the performance of the Board of Commissioners considers several criteria, including the attendance rate of internal and joint meetings with The Board of Directors as well as the overall performance of the Company. The performance assessment of the Board of Commissioners is an independent process carried out by the Company's shareholders at the Annual GMS.","mendapatkan Laporan Performance Management setiap 6 (enam) bulan sekali yang dijadikan sebagai tolak ukur penilaian pada akhir tahun. ## Kebijakan Remunerasi

[SEOJK 2.g.4b][GRI 2-19] [GRI 2-20]
Proses pengusulan dan penetapan remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi diajukan oleh Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi kepada Dewan Komisaris. Berdasarkan pengajuan tersebut, Dewan Komisaris akan mengkaji dan menyampaikannya dalam RUPS. Pengajuan yang diberikan oleh Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi terkait pada struktur, kebijakan, dan besarnya remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi. Perseroan memberikan remunerasi kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas dedikasi dan kontribusi yang diberikan kepada Perseroan. Perseroan menilai tidak adanya keterkaitan secara langsung antara remunerasi dan kinerja Perseroan, namun besaran remunerasi ditentukan berdasarkan pencapaian kinerja Perseroan.

## Nomination Policy

In carrying out its function, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee performs the following procedures:

1. Compiling the composition and nomination process of members of the Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.
2. Formulating policies and criteria required in the process of nominating candidates for members of The Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.
3. Identifying candidates who meet the criteria.
4. Assisting in the evaluation of the performance of members of The Board of Directors and/or members of the Board of Commissioners.
5. Developing programs to enhance the ability of members of The Board of Directors and/or Commissioners.
6. Reviewing and proposing qualified candidates as members of the Board of Commissioners and/or candidates for members of the Board of Directors to the Board of Commissioners to be submitted to the General Meeting of Shareholders.
7. The selection process is carried out before the term of office expires or when requested by the Board of Commissioners or if there is a vacancy.

## Remuneration Policy



The process of proposing and determining the remuneration of the Board of Commissioners and Directors is submitted by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to the Board of Commissioners. Based on the proposal, the Board of Commissioners will review and present it to the General Meeting of Shareholders. The proposal provided by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee relates to the structure, policy, and amount of remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and Directors. The Company provides remuneration to the Board of Commissioners and Directors as a form of appreciation for the dedication and contribution given to the Company. The Company evaluates that there is no direct correlation between remuneration and the Company's performance, but the amount of remuneration is determined based on the Company's performance achievement.","## Kebijakan Nominasi

## [SEOJK 2.g.4b]

Pada 2023, total remunerasi yang diterima Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi mencakup gaji/honorarium, tunjangan, fasilitas, serta tantiem adalah sebesar Rp30,50 miliar.

## Remuneration to The Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners in 2023

In 2023, the total remuneration received by the Board of Commissioners and Directors, including salary/ honorarium, allowances, facilities, and bonuses was Rp30,50 billion.

## KOMITE AUDIT

Audit Committee

Komite Audit dibentuk oleh dan bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris dalam membantu melaksanakan tugas dan fungsi Dewan Komisaris. Dalam pelaksanaannya, Komite Audit melakukan pemantauan, pengkajian, dan pemberian jaminan atas integritas dan efektivitas dari laporan keuangan, manajemen risiko, dan kontrol internal. Komite Audit juga memantau penerapan fungsi audit internal, serta kualifikasi serta independensi Auditor Eksternal.

## Pengangkatan dan Pemberhentian

Komite Audit diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Dewan Komisaris untuk masa jabatan 2 (dua) tahun. Komite Audit bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris.

## Komposisi dan Profil

Per 31 Desember 2023, komposisi Komite Audit berjumlah 3 (tiga) orang, dengan 1 (satu) di antaranya menjabat sebagai ketua yang merupakan Komisaris Independen. Seluruh anggota Komite Audit telah memenuhi kriteria keahlian dan independensi yang dipersyaratkan dalam ketentuan yang berlaku.

Anggota : Hidajat Hoesni

The Audit Committee is a committee established by and accountable to the Board of Commissioners to assist in carrying out the duties and functions of the Board of Commissioners. In carrying out its responsibilities, the Audit Committee monitors, assesses, and provides assurance on the integrity and effectiveness of financial reporting, risk management, and internal control. The Audit Committee also monitors the implementation of internal audit functions, as well as the qualifications and independence of the External Auditor.

## Appointment and Termination

The Audit Committee is appointed and terminated by the Board of Commissioners for a tenure of 2 (two) years. The Audit Committee answers to the Board of Commissioners.

## Composition and Profiles

As of December 31, 2023, the Audit Committee consisted of 3 (three) members, with 1 (one) of them serving as chairman who is an independent Commissioner. All members of the Audit Committee have met the expertise and independence criteria required by applicable regulations.

## Independensi [SEOJK 2.g.6g]

Independensi Komite Audit tercermin dari komposisi anggota Komite Audit yang terdiri dari Ketua yang dijabat oleh Komisaris Independen dan 2 (dua) anggota profesional yang berasal dari luar Perseroan.

In more details, the Audit Committee's duties and responsibilities at least include:

1. Reviewing financial information that will be issued by an Issuer or Public Company to the public and/or authorities, including financial statements, projections, and other reports related to Issuer or Public Company financial information;
2. Reviewing compliance with regulations related to the activities of the Issuer or Public Company;
3. Providing an independent opinion in the event of a difference of opinion between management and the Accountant over the services rendered;
4. Providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the appointment of Accountants based on independence, scope of assignment, and service fees;
5. Reviewing the implementation of the internal auditor's examination and overseeing the implementation of follow-up actions by the Board of Directors on internal auditor findings;
6. Reviewing the activities of risk management implementation by the Board of Directors, if the Issuer or Public Company does not have a risk monitoring function under the Board of Commissioners;
7. Reviewing complaints related to the accounting and financial reporting process of the Issuer or Public Company;
8. Reviewing and providing advice to the Board of Commissioners regarding the potential conflict of interest of the Issuer or Public Company; and
9. Maintaining the confidentiality of documents, data, and information of the Issuer or Public Company.

## Independence

## Rapat [SEOJK 2.g.6i]

Komite Audit mengadakan rapat secara berkala paling sedikit 1 (satu) kali dalam 3 (tiga) bulan. Rapat Komite Audit dapat diselenggarakan, apabila dihadiri oleh lebih dari $1 / 3$ (satu per dua) jumlah anggota. Setiap hasil rapat Komite Audit dituangkan ke dalam risalah rapat, termasuk apabila terdapat perbedaan pendapat (dissenting opinion), yang ditandatangani oleh seluruh anggota Komite Audit yang hadir dan disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris.

Berikut adalah rapat Komite Audit yang diadakan pada tahun 2023 dan kehadiran anggotanya.

## Meetings

The Audit Committee holds periodic meetings at least once every 3 (three) months. The Audit Committee meeting can be held if attended by more than $1 / 3$ (one per two) of the members. The minutes of each Audit Committee meeting, including dissenting opinions, if any, are signed by all attending members and submitted to the Board of Commissioners.

The following is the meetings held by the Audit Committee in 2023 and the attendance of its members.

Selama tahun 2023 anggota Komite Audit tidak mengikuti pelatihan, akan tetapi telah melakukan pengembangan kompetensi secara mandiri untuk tetap mengikuti perkembangan standar dan industri.

## Laporan Kegiatan [SEOJK 2.g.6j]

Berikut adalah kegiatan-kegiatan yang telah dilakukan oleh Komite Audit selama tahun 2023:

1. Melaksanakan pertemuan rutin baik internal maupun dengan mengundang pihak lain seperti manajemen Perseroan khususnya Unit Audit Internal, Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris;
2. Meninjau kondisi proyek dilapangan untuk memahami status dan kendala yang dihadapi;
3. Melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap laporan keuangan triwulanan dan tahunan Perseroan sebelum diterbitkan;
4. Membahas laporan hasil analisis dan observasi atas pelaksanaan kegiatan audit internal yang dilakukan oleh Unit Audit Internal;

## Trainings and Competency Development

In 2023 the members of the Audit Committee did not attend training, but have conducted self improvement in their competence to stay abreast to the standard and industry development.

## Activity Report

These are activities of the Audit Committee in 2023:

1. Conduct regular meetings, both internal and with invitations to other parties, such as the Company's management, especially the Internal Audit Unit;
2. Conduct field reviews to determine the status and challenges of the projects faced by the Company in carrying out its operations;
3. Conduct examinations of the Company's quarterly and annual financial statements of the Company before they are published;

# KOMITE NOMINASI DAN REMUNERASI 

## Nomination And Remuneration Committee

[SEOJK 2.g.7] [POJK E.1]

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bertugas untuk memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris terhadap struktur, kebijakan, dan besarnya remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi untuk disampaikan dalam RUPS.

## Pengangkatan dan Pemberhentian

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Dewan Komisaris untuk masa jabatan 2 (dua) tahun. Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris.

## Komposisi dan Profil

Per 31 Desember 2023, komposisi Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi berjumlah 3 (tiga) orang, dengan 1 (satu) di antaranya menjabat sebagai ketua. Seluruh anggota Komite Audit telah memenuhi kriteria keahlian dan independensi yang dipersyaratkan dalam ketentuan yang berlaku.

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is responsible for providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners on the structure, policies, and amount of remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and Directors to be presented at the General Meeting of Shareholders.

## Appointment and Termination

Nomination and Remuneration Committee is appointed and terminated by the Board of Commissioners for a tenure of 2 (two) years. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee answers to the Board of Commissioners.

## Composition and Profiles



As of December 31, 2023, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee consisted of 3 (three) members, with 1 (one) of them serving as chairman. All members of the Audit Committee have met the expertise and independence criteria required by applicable regulations.","5. ## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab [SEOJK 2.g.7i]

Pedoman Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi mengatur tugas dan tanggung jawabnya sebagai berikut:

1. Menyiapkan dan memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris terkait penentuan komposisi anggota Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris, kebijakan dan kriteria yang dibutuhkan dalam proses nominasi, dan kebijakan evaluasi kinerja bagi anggota Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris untuk kemudian disampaikan dalam RUPS.
2. Memberikan rekomendasi terhadap kebijakan remunerasi untuk Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi untuk disampaikan dalam RUPS.
3. Melakukan evaluasi terhadap remunerasi dan kinerja anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi.
4. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai program pengembangan kemampuan anggota Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris.
5. Menerima laporan keuangan Perseroan.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The Charter of Nomination and Remuneration Committee stipulates its duties and responsibilities as follows:

1. Prepare and provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the determination of the composition of the Board of Directors and Commissioners, policies and criteria required in the nomination process, and performance evaluation policies for members of the Board of Directors and Commissioners to be conveyed in the GMS.
2. Provide recommendations on remuneration policies for the Board of Commissioners and The Board of Directors to be conveyed in the GMS.
3. Conduct evaluations on remuneration and performance of members of the Board of Commissioners and Directors.
4. Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the development program of the Board of Directors and Commissioners' members.


5. Receive the Company's financial reports.","[TABLE REMOVED]

## Rapat [SEOJK 2.g.7k]

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi mengadakan rapat secara berkala paling sedikit 1 (satu) kali dalam 4 (empat) bulan. ## Independence

Based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee Guidelines, all members of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee are required to carry out their roles and responsibilities independently and objectively. In making decisions and conducting relationships at all levels, all members of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee are committed to avoiding any form of conflict of interest.

## Meetings

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee holds periodic meetings at least once every 4 (four) months. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee meeting can be held if attended by more than $1 / 2$ (one per two) of the members. The minutes of each meeting, including dissenting opinions, if any, are signed by all attending members and submitted to the Board of Commissioners.

## Laporan Kegiatan [SEOJK 2.g.71]

Berikut adalah kegiatan-kegiatan yang telah dilakukan oleh Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi selama tahun 2023:

1. Melakukan seleksi terhadap calon anggota Dewan Komisaris sebagai pengganti anggota Dewan Komisaris yang telah mengajukan pengunduran diri;
2. Membahas dan mengajukan komposisi Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris untuk diputuskan dalam RUPS Tahunan 2023;
3. Memberikan rekomendasi, pengusulan serta pengajuan atas remunerasi yang diberikan kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi pada 2023.

## Activity Report

These are the activities of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee in 2023:

1. Conducted a selection process to find a member of the Board of Commissioners as a substitute to a member of the Board that had given his resignation;
2. Discussed and proposed the composition of the Board of Directors and Commissioners to be decided at the 2023 Annual GMS.
3. Provided recommendations, proposals, and submissions on the remuneration given to the Board of Commissioners and Directors in 2023.

## KOMITE LAIN

## Other Committees

Sampai dengan 31 Desember 2023, Perseroan tidak membentuk komite lain maupun Dewan Pengawas Syariah.

## SEKRETARIS PERUSAHAAN

## Corporate Secretary

Sekretaris Perusahaan berperan sebagai pejabat penghubung (liaison officer) antara Perseroan dan Pemegang Saham, regulator serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

## Pengangkatan dan Pemberhentian

Sekretaris Perusahaan diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Direksi, serta bertanggungjawab kepada Direktur Utama.

## Profil

Berikut adalah profil Sekretaris Perusahaan.

As of December 31, 2023, the Company had not established other committees or Sharia Supervisory Board.

## [SEOJK 2.g.9] [POJK E.1]

Corporate Secretary is a liaison officer between the Company and its Shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

## Appointment and Termination

Corporate Secretary is appointed and terminated by The Board of Directors, and accountable to the President Director.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Sekretaris Perusahaan memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab yaitu:

1. Bertindak sebagai koordinator dalam perencanaan, pelaksanaan dan evaluasi atas semua aspek yang berkaitan dengan hubungan antara Perseroan dan para pemangku kepentingan demi terciptanya pemahaman, hubungan yang harmonis, serta dukungan masyarakat terhadap Perseroan.
2. Bertindak sebagai penghubung Perseroan, khususnya dalam membangun komunikasi dengan pihak-pihak eksternal untuk menyampaikan pesan Perseroan secara tepat untuk mendukung kinerja dan citra Perseroan.
3. Merencanakan dan melaksanakan Rapat Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, Rapat Komite Audit, RUPS, serta paparan publik, pertemuan dengan para pemegang saham, investor, analis, maupun media.
4. Menyimpan dan mendokumentasikan semua kegiatan Perseroan, khususnya yang mungkin diperlukan sebagai bukti pendukung apabila Perseroan menghadapi kondisi khusus akibat suatu kebijakan Perseroan ataupun menghadapi sengketa hukum.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The Corporate Secretary's role and responsibilities include:

1. Acts as a coordinator in planning, implementing, and evaluating all aspects related to the relationship between the Company and stakeholders to create understanding, harmonious relationships, and public support for the Company.
2. Acts as a liaison for the Company, particularly in building communication with external parties to deliver the Company's message accurately to support the Company's performance and image.
3. Plans and conducts meetings of the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, Audit Committee Meetings, GMS, and public presentations, meetings with shareholders, investors, analysts, and media.


4. Stores and documents all Company activities, especially those that may be needed as supporting evidence if the Company faces special conditions due to a Company policy or legal dispute.","# Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

# UNIT AUDIT INTERNAL 

Internal Audit Unit

Unit Audit Internal bertugas untuk melaksanakan audit dan konsultasi secara independen dan objektif.

## Pengangkatan dan pemberhentian

Pengangkatan Kepala Unit Audit Internal harus melalui persetujuan Dewan Komisaris. Secara struktural, Kepala Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Direktur Utama dan bekerja melalui pengarahan dari Komite Audit. Laporan hasil audit disampaikan kepada Direktur Utama dan Komite Audit untuk kemudian diteruskan kepada Dewan Komisaris, disertai dengan pendapat profesional Komite Audit.

Struktur dan Kedudukan Unit Audit Internal
[SEOJK 2.g.10e]

The Internal Audit Unit is responsible for conducting independent and objective audits and consultations.

## Appointment and Termination

The appointment of the Head of the Internal Audit Unit must be approved by the Board of Commissioners. Structurally, the Head of the Internal Audit Unit reports directly to the President Director and works under the guidance of the Audit Committee. Audit findings are reported to the President Director and Audit Committee and are then forwarded to the Board of Commissioners, accompanied by the professional opinion of the Audit Committee.

# UNIT AUDIT INTERNAL 

Internal Audit Unit

Unit Audit Internal bertugas untuk melaksanakan audit dan konsultasi secara independen dan objektif.

## Pengangkatan dan pemberhentian

Pengangkatan Kepala Unit Audit Internal harus melalui persetujuan Dewan Komisaris. Secara struktural, Kepala Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Direktur Utama dan bekerja melalui pengarahan dari Komite Audit. Laporan hasil audit disampaikan kepada Direktur Utama dan Komite Audit untuk kemudian diteruskan kepada Dewan Komisaris, disertai dengan pendapat profesional Komite Audit.

Struktur dan Kedudukan Unit Audit Internal
[SEOJK 2.g.10e]

The Internal Audit Unit is responsible for conducting independent and objective audits and consultations.

## Appointment and Termination

The appointment of the Head of the Internal Audit Unit must be approved by the Board of Commissioners. Structurally, the Head of the Internal Audit Unit reports directly to the President Director and works under the guidance of the Audit Committee. Audit findings are reported to the President Director and Audit Committee and are then forwarded to the Board of Commissioners, accompanied by the professional opinion of the Audit Committee.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab [SEOJK 2.g.10f-g]

Berdasarkan Piagam Audit Internal yang telah disahkan Surat Keputusan Dewan Komisaris tanggal 1 Februari 2010, tugas dan tanggung jawab Unit Audit Internal adalah sebagai berikut:

1. Menyusun dan melaksanakan rencana Audit Internal tahunan.
2. Menguji dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan pengendalian internal dan sistem manajemen risiko sesuai dengan kebijakan Perseroan.
3. Memeriksa dan menilai efisiensi dan efektivitas di bidang keuangan, akuntansi, operasional, sumber daya manusia, pemasaran, teknologi informasi dan kegiatan Perseroan lainnya.
4. Memberikan saran perbaikan dan informasi objektif tentang kegiatan yang diperiksa pada semua tingkat manajemen.
5. Membuat laporan hasil audit untuk disampaikan kepada Direktur Utama dan Dewan Komisaris.
6. Memantau, menganalisis, dan melaporkan pelaksanaan tindak lanjut pada perbaikan yang telah disarankan.

## Duties and Responsibilities

Stipulated by the Charter of Internal Audit that has been ratified by the Decree of the Board of Commissioners dated February 1, 2010, the duties and responsibilities of the Internal Audit Unit are as follows:

1. Develop and implement the annual Internal Audit plan.
2. Test and evaluate the implementation of internal controls and risk management systems in accordance with Company policies.
3. Examine and assess efficiency and effectiveness in financial, accounting, operational, human resource, marketing, information technology, and other Company activities.
4. Provide improvement suggestions and objective information about the activities audited at all levels of management.
5. Prepare audit findings report to be presented to the President Director and Board of Commissioners.


6. Monitor, analyze, and report on the implementation of recommended improvements.","# Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik
